features.title: Spotlight Search
features.question: Do you use Spotlight to find files and applications?
features.description: Indexes files, application metadata, messages, and other searchable content across macOS.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this if you use another launcher and do not rely on Finder or Spotlight content search. Background indexing workers will stop.

features.title: Quick Look
features.question: Do you use Spacebar Quick Look previews in Finder?
features.description: Quick Look preview daemon, UI helper, and thumbnail agent used by Finder Spacebar previews.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this if Spacebar previews are unused. Finder icon thumbnails may also be reduced.

features.title: Desktop Widgets
features.question: Do you use desktop or Notification Center widgets?
features.description: Runs WidgetKit processes that keep widget timelines and control descriptors up to date.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this if you do not use widgets. Widget extensions will no longer load in the background.

features.title: Document Versions
features.question: Do you use Browse All Versions for document history?
features.description: Stores macOS Auto Save document revisions for supported Cocoa applications.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this if you rely on Git or editor history instead. File → Revert To → Browse All Versions will stop working.

features.title: Help Indexer
features.question: Allow background Help Center indexing?
features.description: Indexes application help books for Help Viewer search.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this if you do not use Help Viewer search.

features.title: Siri & Dictation
features.question: Do you use Siri or system dictation?
features.description: Provides local speech recognition, Siri assistant services, and system-wide dictation.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this if you never use Siri, the dictation key, or voice control speech pipelines. Voice dictation and Siri will stop.

features.title: Apple Intelligence
features.question: Do you use on-device Apple Intelligence features?
features.description: Hosts generative model runtime, model catalog, and intelligence platform services.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this if you do not use Apple Intelligence writing tools or on-device generative features.

features.title: Proactive Suggestions
features.question: Do you want routine learning and app prediction suggestions?
features.description: Learns routines and usage patterns, and syncs on-device behavior streams for App Prediction and proactive suggestions.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this on a coding-only Mac where proactive suggestions are not useful.

features.title: System Translation
features.question: Do you use system-wide translation features?
features.description: On-device and system translation daemon.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this if translation features are unused.

features.title: Messages & iMessage
features.question: Do you use Messages or iMessage on this Mac?
features.description: Runs the Messages backend, Apple IDS identity services, and related call-history helpers.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this if this Mac is coding-only and does not send or receive iMessage. Messages, iMessage, and related IDS features will stop. App Shortcuts registry is included so Messages extensions do not return.

features.title: FaceTime & Calls
features.question: Do you use FaceTime or Phone Continuity on this Mac?
features.description: Provides CallKit, FaceTime signaling, and AV conference services.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this if you never take FaceTime or Continuity phone calls on this Mac.

features.title: Apple Mail
features.question: Do you use the Apple Mail app?
features.description: Background mail daemon used by the system Mail application.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this if you use another mail client exclusively.

features.title: AirDrop & Continuity
features.question: Do you use AirDrop, Handoff, Continuity Camera, or Universal Clipboard?
features.description: Enables nearby sharing, Handoff, Continuity capture, and related device discovery.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this if you do not share files with nearby Apple devices or use Handoff. AirDrop, Handoff, Continuity Camera, and Universal Clipboard will stop. Core Bluetooth radio remains available for keyboards and headphones.

features.title: Bluetooth Pairing Assistant
features.question: Do you pair new Bluetooth devices in System Settings on this Mac?
features.description: Per-user Bluetooth cloud pairing and GUI pairing handshake support.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this only on a fixed-peripheral machine. New Bluetooth device pairing in the GUI may hang. Keep enabled if you regularly pair headphones or keyboards.

features.title: iCloud Drive
features.question: Do you use iCloud Drive on this Mac?
features.description: Syncs Desktop, Documents, and iCloud Drive containers through CloudDocs and File Provider.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this if files stay local or use Git remotes only. iCloud Drive and related File Provider extensions will stop.

features.title: CloudKit Hub
features.question: Do Apple apps need CloudKit background sync on this Mac?
features.description: Central CloudKit daemon used by many Apple apps for cloud records.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this on a no-iCloud coding target. Apple apps that require CloudKit sync may stop updating cloud data.

features.title: iCloud Settings Sync
features.question: Do you sync app preferences, Safari bookmarks, and related settings via iCloud?
features.description: Syncs key-value defaults, settings, Safari bookmarks/history, and cloud feature gates.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this if settings should stay local to this Mac.

features.title: iCloud Keychain Sync
features.question: Do you sync passwords with iCloud Keychain on this Mac?
features.description: Continuous protected cloud key synchronization for iCloud Keychain.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this only if passwords are managed locally or with a third-party manager. Local keychain login still works.

features.title: iCloud Private Relay
features.question: Do you use iCloud Private Relay?
features.description: Network service proxy used by Private Relay and related privacy proxy paths.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this if Private Relay is unused.

features.title: Mac App Store
features.question: Do you browse and update apps from the Mac App Store?
features.description: App Store catalog, commerce, download, and related store daemon layer.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this if you install software outside the Mac App Store. In-store browsing and update listing will stop. OS Software Update is a separate control.

features.title: App Store Ads
features.question: Do you want App Store promotional and ad privacy agents?
features.description: Engagement, promoted content, and ad privacy daemons related to the App Store.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this to remove App Store advertising and engagement background agents.

features.title: Music & Books Cloud
features.question: Do you use Apple Music, iTunes cloud, or Books library sync?
features.description: Background media store cloud daemons for Music and Books.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this if you do not use Apple media store cloud libraries on this Mac.

features.title: Software Update Daemons
features.question: Should macOS keep Software Update daemons running in the background?
features.description: Checks for and prepares macOS and related software updates.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this only on experimental machines. Automatic and manual softwareupdate flows may stop until re-enabled.

features.title: Content Caching
features.question: Do you run Content Caching for other Apple devices on your network?
features.description: Local Apple content cache server and locator services.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this if Content Caching is unused. Other devices will download directly from Apple.

features.title: Background System Assets
features.question: Allow Apple to download extra system assets in the background?
features.description: Downloads supplemental voices, dictionaries, fonts, aerial wallpaper metadata, and on-device model assets from Apple CDNs.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this if you do not need background asset updates. macOS software updates stay on a separate daemon.

features.title: Install Coordination (Advanced)
features.question: Disable install coordination and FairPlay install helpers?
features.description: Nuclear install and DRM coordination layer used by Mac App Store installs.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this only on experimental target machines after App Store daemons are already off. Coordinated App Store installs will fail.

features.title: Photos Library
features.question: Do you use the Photos app on this Mac?
features.description: Core Photos library daemon for opening and maintaining the photo library.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this if Photos.app is not used. The library on disk remains but the daemon will not run.

features.title: Photos Analysis
features.question: Do you need Photos memories, face recognition, or media analysis?
features.description: Analyzes the photo library for faces, objects, memories, and related ML features.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this if Photos analysis features are not needed. Memories and face grouping will stop.

features.title: Camera Stack
features.question: Do you use the built-in or USB camera on this Mac?
features.description: Camera capture and Core Media IO assistant services.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this on a no-camera coding target. Built-in and many USB camera capture paths will stop.

features.title: Dynamic Wallpapers
features.question: Do you use aerial or dynamic video wallpapers?
features.description: Background wallpaper export helpers used for dynamic wallpaper assets.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this if you use a static desktop picture. Static wallpapers continue to work; aerial video wallpapers will not.

features.title: Location Services
features.question: Do applications need the location of this Mac?
features.description: Core Location hub, permission agent, GeoServices map tiles, and related geo helpers.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this if maps, weather location, and app geolocation are unnecessary. Some Wi‑Fi region helpers may degrade. Automatic time zone can be affected.

features.title: Find My
features.question: Do you use Find My Mac or the Find My network?
features.description: Device locate, offline finding, and Find My beacon services.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this on an experimental machine if remote lock and offline finding are not required. Lost-device recovery features will stop.

features.title: HomeKit
features.question: Do you use HomeKit or the Home app?
features.description: Home automation hub, energy, events, and Thread commissioner services.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this if you do not control HomeKit accessories from this Mac.

features.title: Screen Time
features.question: Do you use Screen Time, Live Activities, or app usage limits?
features.description: Tracks usage, Live Activities, social layer suggestions, and managed settings.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this if you do not use Screen Time reports, Downtime, or Live Activities.

features.title: Focus Modes
features.question: Do you use Focus or Do Not Disturb automation?
features.description: Focus and Do Not Disturb policy server.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this if Focus modes are unused.

features.title: Reminders
features.question: Do you use the Reminders app?
features.description: Background Reminders sync and list maintenance daemon.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this if Reminders is unused.

features.title: Quick Note
features.question: Do you use the Quick Note hot corner or linked-note indicators?
features.description: The paper that slides in from a screen corner, plus the Synapse backlink indicator that appears when a page or file has a linked note.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this if you do not use Quick Note, the Notes hot corner, or document backlink indicators. Notes.app itself still opens.

features.title: Contacts & People
features.question: Do you use Contacts, People suggestions, or Family circle services?
features.description: Contacts database, AddressBook helpers, People, and Family circle agents.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this if Contacts, People suggestions, and Family Sharing circle features are unused.

features.title: Family Follow-Up Agents
features.question: Keep Family Sharing follow-up agents?
features.description: Idle Family Sharing follow-up and related leftover agents.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this if Family Sharing follow-ups are unused.

features.title: Wallet & Apple Pay
features.question: Do you use Wallet, Apple Pay, or passes on this Mac?
features.description: FinanceKit, PassKit, NFC, and secure element related services.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this if payments and passes are never used on this Mac.

features.title: Game Center & Controllers
features.question: Do you play games or use Game Controllers on this Mac?
features.description: Game Center, game policy, controller, and sports session services.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this on a coding-only Mac without games or controllers.

features.title: Classroom & Assessment
features.question: Do you use Schoolwork, Classroom, or assessment lockdown?
features.description: Student and assessment agents for education environments.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this on non-school machines.

features.title: Clock Timers
features.question: Do you use Clock app timers and alarms?
features.description: Mobile timer daemon used by Clock features.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this if Clock timers are unused.

features.title: Time Machine
features.question: Do you use Time Machine backups?
features.description: Time Machine backup engine, helper, and notification agent.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this if no Time Machine destination is used.

features.title: Notification Center
features.question: Do you need Notification Center banners and Apple Push?
features.description: Core user notification servers and Apple Push Service.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this only on aggressive profiles. Most banners and remote pushes will stop.

features.title: Extra Notification Agents
features.question: Keep Software Update, Safari, iCloud, and USB notification agents?
features.description: Peripheral notification delegates for updates, Safari web push, family, and USB alerts.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this to remove secondary notification agents while leaving core system plumbing intact if Notification Center is still enabled.

features.title: Analytics & Diagnostics
features.question: Send diagnostic and usage analytics to Apple?
features.description: Core analytics reporting hub and related diagnostic reporters.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this to stop analytics upload agents. Unified logging remains available.

features.title: Extra Telemetry
features.question: Allow input, audio, USB, and systemstats telemetry daemons?
features.description: Additional telemetry collectors, including systemstats, input, audio, and USB probes.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this on a lean coding profile to reduce idle collectors.

features.title: Crash Reporter Dialogs
features.question: Do you want “Application Quit Unexpectedly” crash dialogs?
features.description: Intercepts crashes, can write diagnostic reports, and symbolicates system crash logs.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this for fewer interruption dialogs. Keep enabled if you need local crash reports for native debugging.

features.title: Experiment Enrollment
features.question: Allow Apple A/B experiment enrollment on this Mac?
features.description: Downloads and applies Apple Trial feature-flag experiment payloads.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this to stop experiment enrollment and related background fetches.

features.title: Network Diagnostics Analytics
features.question: Keep network symptoms analytics enabled?
features.description: Collects network quality and symptoms metrics.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this to reduce network analytics collection. Basic connectivity remains.

features.title: Onboarding & Feedback
features.question: Keep new-device outreach, eligibility, Feedback Assistant, and software transparency agents?
features.description: Onboarding, eligibility gates, Feedback Assistant, and software transparency helpers.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this on a locked-down coding image.

features.title: Spoken Content Voices
features.question: Do you need system text-to-speech voices loaded in the background?
features.description: Loads accessibility TTS voice assets and speech synthesizer plugins.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this if Speak Selection, VoiceOver speech assets, and related TTS features are unused.

features.title: Hearing Accessibility
features.question: Do you use Sound Recognition, Live Listen, or Background Sounds?
features.description: Hearing accessibility daemon for sound recognition and related features.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this if hearing accessibility features are unused.

features.title: Accessibility Overlays
features.question: Do you use Screen Zoom overlays or accessibility focus rings?
features.description: Renders zoom lenses, focus rings, and related accessibility visuals.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this if you do not use zoom overlays or high-contrast focus indicators. Keep enabled if Screen Zoom is required.

features.title: Enterprise SSO
features.question: Do you use Platform SSO or enterprise single sign-on?
features.description: AppSSO and Platform SSO agents for managed identity providers.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this on personal Macs that are not enrolled in enterprise SSO.

features.title: Remote Management
features.question: Is this Mac enrolled in MDM or Remote Management?
features.description: MDM and remote management client services.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this only on unenrolled machines. Managed profiles and remote management will not function.

features.title: Smart Cards
features.question: Do you use smart cards or hardware tokens?
features.description: CryptoTokenKit smart card host daemon.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this if no smart cards are used.

features.title: Kerberos & GSSAPI
features.question: Do you join Active Directory or use Kerberos tickets?
features.description: Kerberos digest, GSS credential, and gssd services.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this on standalone personal Macs without directory accounts.

features.title: Captive Portal Assistant
features.question: Auto-detect hotel and airport Wi‑Fi login pages?
features.description: Detects captive networks and presents login sheets.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this on home or office networks. You can still open a browser manually for captive portals.

features.title: Cellular Stack
features.question: Does this Mac need CoreTelephony / cellular services?
features.description: CommCenter telephony stack used on cellular-capable Macs.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this on Wi‑Fi-only MacBooks without cellular hardware.

features.title: Wi‑Fi Menu Agent
features.question: Keep the Wi‑Fi menu extras and hotspot assistant agent?
features.description: User-level Wi‑Fi notifications and auto-hotspot related agent.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this if the Wi‑Fi menu icon is hidden and auto-hotspot is unused. Core Wi‑Fi remains available.

features.title: Legacy Network Services
features.question: Do you need NetBIOS name services or IPv6 Internet Sharing?
features.description: Legacy NetBIOS name resolution and the DHCPv6 server used when this Mac shares its connection.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this on modern single-Mac networks that do not use NetBIOS or Internet Sharing. Regular Wi‑Fi and Ethernet stay available.

features.title: Network Automount
features.question: Do you use transparent NFS or SMB automount under /net?
features.description: Autofs daemon for automatic network share mounting.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this if you mount shares manually in Finder. Manual SMB connections still work.

features.title: iPhone in Finder
features.question: Show connected iPhone or iPad devices in Finder?
features.description: Apple Media Products device discovery for Finder sidebar device entries.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this if you do not sync devices through Finder. Xcode and usbmux-based tools continue to work.

features.title: Image Capture Discovery
features.question: Auto-discover scanners and cameras for Image Capture?
features.description: Image Capture device discovery daemon.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this if scanners and PTP cameras are unused.

features.title: Accessory Firmware Updates
features.question: Allow background firmware updates for Apple accessories?
features.description: Accessory updater and UARP firmware services.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this if accessory firmware is managed rarely. Re-enable before hardware service visits.

features.title: Repair Diagnostics
features.question: Keep hardware repair verification agents running?
features.description: Repair diagnostics and related verification helpers.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this on coding machines that do not need background repair checks.

features.title: Power Diagnostics
features.question: Collect detailed power and performance diagnostic logs?
features.description: PerfPower diagnostic services separate from core power management.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this to drop diagnostic collectors. Charging and thermal control remain.

features.title: System Spell Check
features.question: Do you use system-wide spell checking?
features.description: AppleSpell system spelling and grammar service.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this if editors provide their own spelling tools.

features.title: Resume Windows After Login
features.question: Restore open apps and windows after logout?
features.description: Transparent Application Lifecycle agent for session restore.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this for cleaner logins without restored windows.

features.title: Encrypted Volume Banners
features.question: Show password banners for encrypted external APFS volumes?
features.description: User agent that presents FileVault and encrypted volume notifications.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this if you do not attach encrypted external volumes that need UI banners.

features.title: Cursor Language Indicator
features.question: Do you need the floating language pill while typing?
features.description: Shows a temporary language indicator near the text caret when switching layouts.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this only on single-language keyboards. Multi-layout users should keep it enabled.

features.title: Download Quarantine Alerts
features.question: Show “this file was downloaded from the Internet” and Gatekeeper warning dialogs?
features.description: CoreServices UI agent that presents quarantine and unidentified-developer alerts.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this on a power-user machine if you do not want those warning dialogs. Gatekeeper policy itself is controlled on the Security tab.

features.title: Safari Background Helpers
features.question: Do you use Safari and its background helpers?
features.description: Safari platform support, Safe Browsing, and related background agents.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this if you use another browser exclusively.

features.title: Passkeys & AutoFill
features.question: Do you use Safari Passkeys or system AutoFill?
features.description: Authentication Services agent for Passkeys and password AutoFill.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this only if Safari Passkeys and AutoFill are never used. Third-party password managers can still work.

features.title: Legacy Maintenance Helpers
features.question: Keep rarely used maintenance helpers such as warmd and IMK launch agent?
features.description: Small legacy or low-value helpers validated as removable on coding targets.
features.disableGuidance: Disable this for additional lean cleanup on coding machines.
